status: DRAFT - Stage 4A reconciliation. Not reviewed. Not published.

entities.label: Student
entities.purpose: The child whose records are under review. Exactly one per case; other entities never mix facts across students.
identityKeys: documented name + date of birth as written
entities.instanceBoundary: One per case. A second student name in the record is a CROSS_ENTITY signal, never merged.
entities.temporalScope: Stable; grade changes over time via enrollment.

entities.label: Parent / guardian / educational decision-maker
entities.purpose: A person holding parental rights (parent, guardian, surrogate, or adult student after transfer).
entities.instanceBoundary: One per person; role field distinguishes parent, guardian, surrogate, adult student.
entities.temporalScope: Rights may transfer at age of majority.

entities.label: School
entities.purpose: School the student attends or will attend.

entities.label: Public agency (district / LEA)
entities.purpose: Agency responsible for FAPE; changes on transfer.

entities.label: Enrollment / transfer event
entities.purpose: Enrollment, withdrawal or transfer; needed for transfer rules and timeline exceptions.

entities.label: Referral / request for evaluation
entities.purpose: The request that starts an initial evaluation or reevaluation.

entities.label: Concern
entities.purpose: A concern raised by a parent, teacher or the student, as written. Starts Chain 1 and Chain 7.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per distinct concern statement; same concern repeated in several documents is linked, not merged, unless the text matches.

entities.label: Pre-referral or general-education intervention
entities.purpose: Instruction or intervention provided before/during referral (RTI/MTSS).

entities.label: Consent event
entities.purpose: A parent's consent, refusal or revocation for a specific activity. Type is essential: evaluation consent is not service consent.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per consent document per activity; evaluation, reevaluation, initial-services and revocation are separate instances.

entities.label: Evaluation (initial or reevaluation)
entities.purpose: One evaluation process covering several assessments; holds the completion date used for timelines.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per evaluation cycle; a reevaluation is a new instance.
entities.temporalScope: Dated span from first assessment to completion.

entities.label: Evaluation report
entities.purpose: A written report by one evaluator or discipline (psychoeducational, speech-language, OT, FBA, private/IEE).
entities.instanceBoundary: One per report document; a private evaluation or IEE is its own instance with isIndependent=true.

entities.label: Assessment administration
entities.purpose: One administration of one instrument (or subtest battery) on one date.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per instrument per date. Same instrument on two dates = two instances.

entities.label: Assessment score
entities.purpose: A single reported score. Measured value; never mixed with interpretation. Comparable only with same instrument, subtest, score type and norm basis.

entities.label: Observation
entities.purpose: A documented observation of the student (classroom or other setting).

entities.label: Parent or teacher input
entities.purpose: Input gathered from parent/teacher (interview, questionnaire, rating scale narrative).

entities.label: Evaluation finding / identified need
entities.purpose: A professional interpretation in an evaluation: an identified need or area of difficulty. Start of Chain 2.

entities.label: Evaluation recommendation
entities.purpose: A recommendation in an evaluation report (service, accommodation, goal area, setting). Start of Chain 3.

entities.label: Eligibility determination
entities.purpose: The group's decision on disability category and need for special education.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per determination (initial or at reevaluation).

entities.label: Exclusionary-factor review
entities.purpose: Documented consideration of factors that must not be the primary cause (SLD) or determinant factor (all categories).

entities.label: Team member certification (SLD)
entities.purpose: Each member's written agreement or dissent with the SLD report.

entities.label: IEP document version
entities.purpose: One IEP document (initial, annual, amended copy, or draft). Versions form Chain 6.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per distinct document version; a draft and a final with the same date are two instances.

entities.label: IEP Team meeting
entities.purpose: A meeting at which the IEP was developed, reviewed or revised.

entities.label: Meeting notice
entities.purpose: Written notice of an IEP meeting.

entities.label: Meeting participant / excusal
entities.purpose: A person and role at a meeting, or their written excusal.

entities.label: Present level statement
entities.purpose: A present-levels statement for one area, possibly citing scores.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per area per IEP version.

entities.label: Annual goal
entities.purpose: One measurable annual goal in one IEP version.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per goal per IEP version; a revised goal in an amendment is a new instance linked by supersedes.
entities.temporalScope: Goal date bounded by IEP span.

entities.label: Benchmark / short-term objective
entities.purpose: Intermediate step under a goal; required for alternate-assessment students.

entities.label: Progress measurement and reporting plan
entities.purpose: How and when progress is reported to parents.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per IEP version (or per goal if stated per goal).

entities.label: Service / support provision
entities.purpose: A special education service, related service, supplementary aid, program modification or personnel support in one IEP version.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per service line per IEP version.
entities.temporalScope: Start date to end date within IEP span.

entities.label: Accommodation or modification
entities.purpose: A classroom or testing accommodation or a modification.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per item per IEP version.

entities.label: Assistive technology device or service
entities.purpose: AT considered or provided.

entities.label: Educational placement / LRE statement
entities.purpose: Setting decision and the explanation of non-participation with nondisabled peers.

entities.label: State/district assessment participation
entities.purpose: Regular vs alternate assessment and testing accommodations.

entities.label: Special factor consideration
entities.purpose: Team consideration of behavior, English proficiency, Braille, communication, AT.

entities.label: Extended school year determination
entities.purpose: IEP Team's individual ESY decision.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per IEP version (or per decision date).

entities.label: Transition plan
entities.purpose: Measurable postsecondary goals and transition services.

entities.label: Age-of-majority statement
entities.purpose: IEP statement that the student was informed of rights transferring.

entities.label: Progress report
entities.purpose: A periodic report on progress toward goals.

entities.label: Progress data point
entities.purpose: One measured value for one goal on one date.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per goal per date per measure.

entities.label: Service delivery record
entities.purpose: A logged session or period of delivered service.
entities.instanceBoundary: One per logged session or period.

entities.label: Prior written notice
entities.purpose: Agency notice of a proposal or refusal.

entities.label: Procedural safeguards notice provision
entities.purpose: Record that the safeguards notice was given.

entities.label: Copy provided to parent
entities.purpose: Record that a copy of the IEP or evaluation report was given to the parent.

entities.label: Parent communication
entities.purpose: Letter, email or call log between parent and school.

entities.label: Independent educational evaluation request
entities.purpose: A parent's IEE request and the agency response.

entities.label: Records request
entities.purpose: A parent request to inspect/review records.

entities.label: IEP amendment
entities.purpose: A change between annual reviews, by meeting or written agreement.

entities.label: Documented disagreement
entities.purpose: A recorded disagreement by a parent or team member.

entities.label: Functional behavior assessment
entities.purpose: An FBA (where conducted).

entities.label: Behavior intervention plan
entities.purpose: A BIP or positive behavior supports in the IEP.

relationships.label: Concern is part of referral
relationships.evidenceForLink: Referral text names the concern, or concern appears in the referral document.

relationships.label: Referral leads to evaluation
relationships.evidenceForLink: Evaluation report or consent references the referral/request.

relationships.label: Concern area covered by an assessment
relationships.evidenceForLink: Evaluation report states the assessment addresses the concern/area; similar wording alone is not evidence.

relationships.label: Administration produced score
relationships.evidenceForLink: Score appears in the same report table/section as the administration.

relationships.label: Evaluation includes report
relationships.evidenceForLink: Report is part of the evaluation cycle (dates/ref).

relationships.label: Consent authorizes evaluation
relationships.evidenceForLink: Consent document names the evaluation; dates consistent.

relationships.label: Present level is baseline for goal
relationships.evidenceForLink: Goal is in the same area and cites/quotes the present-level baseline.

relationships.label: Service works on goal
relationships.evidenceForLink: IEP links the goal number/area to the service line.

relationships.label: Data point measures goal
relationships.evidenceForLink: Progress report lists the value under this goal.

relationships.label: Recommendation reflected as service
relationships.evidenceForLink: IEP service matches the recommendation and the record links them (same provider type and purpose, or explicit reference).

relationships.label: Refusal/decision on recommendation explained
relationships.evidenceForLink: PWN names the recommendation or the refused action.

relationships.label: IEP developed at meeting
relationships.evidenceForLink: IEP meeting date field or meeting notes name the IEP.

relationships.label: IEP provides service
relationships.evidenceForLink: Service appears in that IEP version.

relationships.label: IEP contains goal
relationships.evidenceForLink: Goal appears in that IEP version.

relationships.label: Later version supersedes earlier
relationships.evidenceForLink: Later document states it replaces/amends the earlier one, or dates show succession with same student.
relationships.note: Self-relationship; DP-2 joins two different entity IDs only, so version comparison is non-executable (GAP).

relationships.label: Concern considered at meeting
relationships.evidenceForLink: Meeting notes or IEP parent-concerns section records the concern.

relationships.label: Meeting decision explained by PWN
relationships.evidenceForLink: PWN dated at/after meeting and describes its decision.

relationships.label: Initial service consent for IEP
relationships.note: Second consent<->evaluation pair is a different entity pair; allowed.

chains.label: Concern to assessment (v7 'Concern to testing', expanded)
chains.requiredEvidence: Each link needs its own sourced relationship fact; matching words between concern and test name are not sufficient.
commonMissingLinks: Referral concern with no assessment in that area
possibleContradictions: Report says area assessed but no instrument listed

chains.label: Need to progress (v7, expanded)
chains.requiredEvidence: Sourced link for each step; a goal 'covering' a need requires the IEP to tie them (area + reference), not similarity alone.
commonMissingLinks: Goal with no progress data after a reporting date has passed
possibleContradictions: Progress report tracks a goal that is not in the current IEP

chains.label: Recommendation reconciliation (v7 'Recommendation to plan', expanded)
links: Documented decision or PWN, or unresolved question
chains.requiredEvidence: Recommendation must be verified; 'not reflected' requires full coverage of the IEP pages (coverage record), never inferred from an unread page.
commonMissingLinks: Recommendation with no matching provision and no recorded reason
possibleContradictions: Provision quantity differs from recommended quantity

chains.label: Procedural chronology (new)
chains.requiredEvidence: Every date must be a verified fact tied to the same student and the same cycle (initial vs reevaluation).

chains.label: Progress trajectory (new)
chains.requiredEvidence: Same measure and unit across baseline, target and data points; otherwise rates are not computed.
possibleContradictions: Data point unit differs from goal unit

chains.label: Document evolution (new)
links: Progress and service records tied to each version
chains.requiredEvidence: Version order must come from document statements or dates; provisions are compared only between versions linked by supersedes/amends.
possibleContradictions: Progress report refers to superseded goal
Service minutes differ between versions without amendment

chains.label: Parent participation (new)
links: Prior written notice or outstanding question
chains.requiredEvidence: Parent's own statements (intake) are person statements and may start the chain but never count as document evidence of consideration.
commonMissingLinks: Concern raised in writing with no recorded consideration
possibleContradictions: Notes say parent agreed; parent communication says otherwise

documents.name: Prior written notice
documents.purpose: Agency explanation of each proposal or refusal.
documents.applicability: Whenever the agency proposes or refuses evaluation, identification, placement or FAPE changes.
documents.timing: A reasonable time before the action.
documents.legacyName: Prior written notice for evaluation, eligibility and placement

documents.name: Procedural safeguards notice
documents.applicability: Initial referral/request; once a year; specified events; on request.

documents.name: Consent to evaluate
documents.purpose: Parent's informed written consent to an initial evaluation.

documents.name: Consent for initial provision of services
mayNotApplyWhen: Annual review or amendment (federal); State may differ

documents.name: Exclusionary-factors review
documents.purpose: Documents factors that must not be the primary/determinant cause.
mayNotApplyWhen: Often embedded in eligibility form rather than separate

documents.name: Intervention / RTI data
documents.purpose: Instruction and repeated progress data before/during referral.

documents.name: Meeting notice, attendance page, excusal forms
documents.purpose: Shows notice, who attended, and written excusals.
documents.legacyName: Meeting notice, attendance page, any excusal forms

documents.name: Report cards, State test results, attendance
documents.legacyName: Report cards, state test results, attendance

documents.name: Private evaluations
documents.purpose: Parent-obtained evaluations; must be considered if they meet agency criteria.

documents.name: Draft IEP
documents.purpose: Proposal before finalization; must not be treated as the plan in effect.

documents.name: IEP amendment
documents.applicability: If plan was changed between reviews.

documents.name: Review of existing evaluation data
documents.purpose: Team review of existing data and decision on additional data.

documents.name: Consent to reevaluate
mayNotApplyWhen: Reasonable efforts made and parent did not respond (§300.300(c)(2))

documents.name: Revocation of consent
documents.purpose: Written revocation of consent for services.

documents.name: Transition assessments
documents.applicability: IEP in effect at 16 (or younger per team/State).
mayBeExpectedLaterWhen: Student will reach transition age during next IEP

documents.name: Functional behavior assessment
documents.applicability: When behavior impedes learning (practice) or required in discipline contexts.

documents.name: IEE request and response
documents.purpose: Parent's disagreement and request; agency response.

documents.name: Enrollment record
documents.purpose: Enrollment dates; needed for transfer exception.
documents.applicability: Transfer or timeline exception at issue.

documentAvailabilityStates.meaning: Not among the uploaded documents; says nothing about whether it exists.
Another document refers to it (cite the mention), but it was not uploaded.
Typical holder is the district/provider; request from holder.
Verified condition makes it inapplicable (cite the fact).
Timing not yet reached (e.g. first progress report date in future).
Uploaded but pages unreadable; coverage record lists pages.
A later version exists; earlier one is historical.
Two versions disagree; both kept, conflict raised.
Collection is incomplete and applicability cannot be decided.

conflictPatterns.title: Different consent dates for the same evaluation
conflictPatterns.requiredComparableContext: Same activityType and same evaluation cycle.
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Compare only instances linked to the same evaluation.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Two verified dates for the same consent instance or same linked evaluation.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: The documents give two consent dates. Which date did the school receive consent?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Different evaluation completion dates
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Report date may precede the overall completion.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Same field, same instance, different verified values.
possibleExplanations: Report dated at typing, not completion
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Conflicting eligibility dates
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Eligibility should precede or equal the IEP meeting.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Two verified determination dates, or eligibility after the IEP meeting that relies on it.
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Assessment value differs across documents
conflictPatterns.requiredComparableContext: Same instrument, form, subtest/composite, score type, norm basis and administration date.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: All comparability fields match and values differ.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: The IEP and the evaluation give different numbers for the same test. Which is right?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Goal baseline does not match cited evaluation value
conflictPatterns.requiredComparableContext: Goal cites that instrument/date and same unit.
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Baseline date equals or follows the cited administration.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Goal explicitly cites the score and values differ.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: Where does this goal's starting number come from?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Service frequency/minutes differ between records
conflictPatterns.requiredComparableContext: Same service line in the same IEP version.
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Compare within one version; across versions it is a change, not a conflict (see CP-VERSION-CHANGE).
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Same version, different verified values (e.g. service grid vs LRE page).
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: The plan lists this service twice with different time. Which is correct?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Goal date outside IEP dates
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Goal date expected within IEP span.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Goal date after effective end or before start.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: This goal's date is outside the plan's dates. Is that intended?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Progress report refers to a superseded goal
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Report period after the newer IEP's start.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Reported goal is only in an older version.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: The progress report tracks a goal from the earlier plan. Is there progress data on the current goals?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Recommendation not traceable to IEP
conflictPatterns.temporalRules: Recommendation from report in force at IEP development.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Full IEP coverage and no link or PWN; otherwise NOT SHOWN, not conflict.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: The evaluation recommended something I can't find in the plan. Where is it?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Contradictory service descriptions
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Different verified setting/provider for same line.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: Is this service delivered in class or outside it?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Inconsistent placement statements
conflictPatterns.requiredComparableContext: Same version; school week length known.
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Stated percentage/minutes disagree with summed pull-out minutes beyond rounding (computed, C5).
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: The plan's percentage of time in class doesn't match the service minutes. Which is right?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Current and historical records mixed
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Facts from a superseded version presented as current.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: Which IEP is in effect now?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Assessments compared without equivalence
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Not a conflict: block the comparison and raise a question.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: These two tests measure differently, so their numbers can't be compared directly.
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

conflictPatterns.title: Provision changed between versions without amendment record
conflictPatterns.genuineContradictionWhen: Change mid-year with no amendment or meeting record.
conflictPatterns.reviewQuestion: Services changed between these two plans. Was there a meeting or amendment?
conflictPatterns.evidenceRequirement: Both sides cited as verified facts with source refs; contradiction is never established from one side plus absence.

calculations.label: Days from consent received to evaluation completion
limitations: Receipt date often not stated; signed date is a different fact.
Does not decide compliance - State timeframe and exceptions.
calculations.legacyInputs: start = date consent received; end = last evaluation date
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Days from eligibility decision to IEP meeting
limitations: Annual reviews out of scope.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Day count; T3 may compare to 30 once pack is REVIEWED.
calculations.legacyInputs: start = eligibility date; end = IEP meeting date
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Days from IEP date to service start
limitations: 'As soon as possible' has no number; descriptive only.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Day count; never a compliance verdict.
calculations.legacyInputs: start = IEP date; end = service start date
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Gain needed per week
limitations: Calendar weeks, not instructional weeks.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Pace the goal assumes; not a measure of ambition under Endrew F.
calculations.legacyInputs: from = baseline value; to = target value; start = baseline date; end = goal date

calculations.label: Service minutes per week by setting
limitations: Normalizing monthly to weekly is an assumption.
calculations.legacyInputs: value = minutes per week; group = setting

calculations.label: Evaluation vs present-level difference
limitations: Present-level numbers need their own typed field (extraction).
calculations.legacyInputs: a = evaluation figure; b = present-level figure for the same measure

calculations.label: Annual review due
limitations: Anchor is an interpretation; IEP may state its own due date - prefer the stated one.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Estimated due date; stated date in IEP takes precedence.

calculations.label: Reevaluation due
limitations: Parent/agency may agree reevaluation unnecessary; no anchor fixed by regulation.

calculations.label: Gap to typical reader at baseline
preconditions: Measure is WCPM on unpracticed passages
limitations: Season boundaries not defined by source.
Norms average three products.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Distance from 50th percentile; not a diagnosis.
calculations.legacyInputs: value = baseline WCPM; table = Oral reading fluency norms; row = grade; column = 50th percentile for the season of the baseline date

calculations.label: Gap to typical reader at goal date
preconditions: Grade at goal date must be documented, not assumed
limitations: Projected grade is an assumption unless documented.
calculations.legacyInputs: value = target WCPM; table = Oral reading fluency norms; row = grade at goal date; column = 50th percentile for the season of the goal date

calculations.label: Days since latest goal or annual review date
limitations: Study date is not a verified fact.
calculations.legacyInputs: start = latest goal date or annual review date; end = study date
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Progress toward target (share of gap closed)
limitations: Needs DIVIDE; DIFFERENCE alone insufficient.

calculations.label: Observed rate of improvement
inputs: first and latest progress-measurement value/date for a goal
limitations: Two-point rate ignores variability; slope methods (OLS) are a professional choice.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Compare with C4 as a question, not a verdict.

calculations.label: Delivered vs planned minutes
limitations: Absence of a log entry is not proof a session was missed.

calculations.label: Days from records request to response
limitations: Also 'before any IEP meeting' limb not computed.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Day count; RA1 may compare to 45 when REVIEWED.
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Days notice before meeting
limitations: Federal rule sets no number ('early enough'); some States do.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Descriptive; State overlay may add threshold.
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Days from referral to consent
preconditions: Referral linked (via evaluation) - two-hop join not supported
limitations: Federal rule has no number (SLD: 'promptly'); States vary.
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Days between progress reports
limitations: Requires instance ordering, not supported.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Detect missing periods vs stated schedule.
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Expected vs received progress reports
limitations: Needs COUNT operator.
calculations.permittedInterpretation: Gap is a document request, not a finding of non-reporting.

calculations.label: Change in service minutes between IEP versions
preconditions: Versions linked by supersedes; same service line
limitations: Self-relationship join unsupported.

calculations.label: Days from IEE request to agency response
limitations: 'Without unnecessary delay' has no number.
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Days from evaluation completion to eligibility
limitations: Federal rule sets no separate limit; some States do.
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

calculations.label: Days from previous evaluation to reevaluation
limitations: Self-relationship join unsupported.
calculations.dateSemantics: Civil calendar dates; calendar days per §300.11(a); end-start, may be negative.

rows.note: Quantified checks (each need/goal) need EVERY/EXISTS operators.
Needs annual-review report template and progress-vs-goal questions.

dp2Constraints: At most one relationship definition per unordered entity pair (else AMBIGUOUS_RELATIONSHIP).
Rules join at most two entities.
Self-relationships (iep-supersedes-iep) cannot drive a two-instance join.
Only DAYS_BETWEEN executes; bindings shape inferred (GAP-C1).

reconciliation.note: conflictPatterns, factClasses, workflowCoverage, and the EVERY/EXISTS note stay in this ontology and are copied to the versioned specs. They are not DP-1 fields.
